title: JE2 single-terminal-methyl deletion series
scientific_question: What measured-source structural coverage and frozen ESOL applicability-domain profile is observed for the complete unique single-terminal-methyl deletion neighborhood of the MOLDISC-008 JE2 seed?

generation.rule: enumerate every carbon atom with atomic number 6, degree 1 and exactly three hydrogens; delete exactly one such atom; sanitize; canonicalize; deduplicate; sort by canonical isomeric SMILES

evidence.selection_rule: among generated candidates with chemistry PASS and AqSolDB nearest Tanimoto >= 0.4, select highest nearest AqSolDB similarity; exact tie by variant_id

interpretation_boundaries: Generated candidates are E0_HEURISTIC structures and are not experimental observations.
The generation rule is frozen upstream of all AqSolDB and ESOL outputs.
AqSolDB neighboring measurements are contextual source evidence and are not transferred to generated candidates unless an exact canonical structure match exists.
Frozen ESOL values are E1_ML outputs; OUT_OF_DOMAIN values are not promoted to reliable solubility estimates.
The generated candidate selected by structural coverage is not a biological winner and is not inferred to bind the 1KZK target.
No docking, affinity, potency, efficacy, safety, synthesizability or clinical claim is made in MOLDISC-009.
